title: removeItem with tests
prompt: Add a `removeItem(inv, sku)` function to src/inventory.js: it removes the item and returns it, and throws an Error matching /not found/ when the SKU does not exist. Export it, add tests for it in test/inventory.test.js, and make sure `npm test` passes. Do not commit.

title: rename qty to quantity across 5 files
prompt: Rename the item field `qty` to `quantity` everywhere in this repo (src/ and test/), and rename `updateQty` to `updateQuantity`. The CLI `add` command's positional arguments stay in the same order. No occurrence of the word `qty` may remain under src/ or test/. Make sure `npm test` passes. Do not commit.

title: total() ignores discount
prompt: Bug: `total(inv, { taxRate, discount })` in src/pricing.js ignores `discount`. A fractional discount (e.g. 0.1 for 10%) must reduce the subtotal before tax is applied, rounding the discounted subtotal to the nearest cent. Fix it and add a regression test in test/pricing.test.js. Make sure `npm test` passes. Do not commit.

title: tests for formatReceipt
prompt: src/receipt.js has no tests. Write test/receipt.test.js with at least 4 tests for `formatReceipt` covering: one item line per item in SKU order, the subtotal/tax/total lines, right-aligned money columns at the given width, and an empty inventory. Make sure `npm test` passes. Do not commit.

title: InventoryError across modules
prompt: Introduce `export class InventoryError extends Error` in a new src/errors.js with a `code` property. Replace every `throw new Error(...)` under src/ with `throw new InventoryError(message, code)`, using codes NOT_FOUND, DUPLICATE_SKU, INVALID_QTY, INVALID_RATE, USAGE and UNKNOWN_COMMAND as appropriate. Keep the existing messages so the current tests still pass. Make sure `npm test` passes. Do not commit.

title: document the CLI
prompt: Document the command-line interface in README.md under a `## CLI` heading: one subsection or table row per command (`add`, `list`, `total`, `receipt`) with its arguments and an example invocation of `node src/cli.js`. Keep the existing content. Do not change any code. Do not commit.

title: where is tax computed
prompt: Research question, no code changes: where is sales tax computed in this repo, how is rounding handled, and which callers depend on it? Answer in under 120 words with file:line references.

title: make lookups faster
prompt: Make inventory lookups faster. Make sure `npm test` passes. Do not commit.
